transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um... mostly just some issues at work. I do camera work and editing, and I guess... I just keep making these dumb technical mistakes lately. Things I know better than to make. 

Like, um, labeling camera cards wrong, or missing a timecode note. I even exported a client cut with the wrong lower-third graphic the other day, and I swear I had already checked it. It just... it kind of finally scared me into making an appointment.
Do you find yourself having trouble focusing or paying attention to details at work lately?
Um... I don't know. I don't really think so. I mean, I feel like I am paying attention when I'm doing it. It's not that I can't focus, I just... I still make the mistakes anyway. So, I'm not sure.
Have you been feeling more tired than usual lately?
Um... no, not really. I don't think I'm any more tired than normal. Just the usual, I guess.
Have you been feeling anxious or overwhelmed lately?
Um... no. Not really. I mean, work gets busy, but... I wouldn't say I feel overwhelmed. Just... annoyed at myself for the mistakes, I guess. But not anxious.
Do you find that you're forgetting things that you normally wouldn't forget?
Um... no, not really. I mean, my memory is fine. I don't think I'm forgetting anything important.
Have you been feeling sad or down lately?
I don't think so. My mood is... fine. I haven't really noticed feeling down or anything.
Do you feel like your mind is exhausted after working on tasks?
Um... no. Not really. I mean, editing can make for a long day, but... I don't think my mind feels exhausted. It just stays about the same, I guess.
Do you ever feel like you're not really connected to what you're doing, like you're just going through the motions?
Um... no. I don't really get that feeling. I'm usually pretty involved in whatever I'm doing, so... no, not really.
Do you ever feel like you're outside of your body, watching yourself?
No... I don't think so. I've never really felt like that.
Do you ever feel like you're observing yourself from outside your body?
I mean... didn't you just ask me that? Like I said... no. I don't.
Do you ever feel like you're detached from yourself or your surroundings?
No. I feel like we're kind of going in circles with this... but no. I don't.
Do you ever feel like you're unreal or like things around you are unreal?
No. I don't know why you keep asking these... I just feel normal. Just me. Not unreal or anything.
Has anything very stressful or upsetting happened to you recently?
No. Not really. Just... normal life, I guess. Nothing major.
Have you ever experienced something very traumatic or disturbing in your life?
No. Nothing like that. Just... regular life stuff. Nothing traumatic.
Have you noticed any change in yourself recently?
No, not really. I'm just... the same as always, I think. Nothing's changed.
Do you feel mentally foggy?
No... I don't think so. My head feels fine. Just... normal, I guess.
Have you recently noticed any changes in your behavior that are unusual for you?
No... I haven't noticed anything unusual. I'm just... doing what I always do, really.
Have you noticed any difficulty learning new information lately?
No... not really. I mean, I pick up new stuff for work fine, so... no. I haven't had any trouble with that.
Do you ever feel like you're in a daze?
No. I don't really space out or anything like that. So... no, not really.
Have you ever felt like you were disconnected from your thoughts or actions?
Um... no. I don't think so. I'm always pretty aware of what I'm doing, so... no.
